description: Fetch a consolidated metrics snapshot for a single stock by ticker: identity (company, exchange, currency, sector, industry, country, ISIN), latest daily price (OHLCV), latest valuation (market cap, P/E, dividend yield, annual dividend per share), the most recent reported financials (revenue, gross/operating income, EBITDA, net income, diluted EPS, free & operating cash flow, total debt, cash, total assets, equity) and a short company description. Prices are in the listing's trading currency; financials in their own sourceCurrency. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN. Read-only.

ticker.description: The stock ticker as Bullrun lists it, e.g. "AAPL", "BMW", "NESN", "6324.T", "0700.HK" or "005930". A bare numeric code is resolved when exactly one listing matches.
